correctness.rationale: Every four-cycle alternating sign vector lies in ker unsigned incidence and has norm two. Two cycles with sole shared edge e have coordinatewise product +/- delta_e, so |z_e| <= 4||P diag(z) P||_F. Summing over edges and using the exact projector Schur/trace identity proves P◦P >= I/(16m). General Cesaro spectral projector formula proves Mhat >= P◦P; the cube product squares and boundary C4 calculation close the quantifiers. Exact Fraction LDL verification of five root graph cases corroborates but does not replace the proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new two-cycle condition forces span of pairwise coordinate products to contain every edge basis vector and quantitatively controls each diagonal compression. Prior statements imply only existence of the eigenspace and a general PSD sum, not positive definiteness of a single summand. Distinguish the new sufficient condition from claims of necessity or full general classification.

Kang supplies identification of that eigenspace and full-support orbitals but not the separating coordinatewise products of localized cycle vectors. The commutant rank framework does not assert injectivity for these root graphs.

originality.rationale: The localized two-cycle certificate and quantitative line-graph mixing positivity implication were not located in the primary literature or available mathematical findings; strongest relevant line-graph paper supplies only the standard incidence/flat-band identity and a distinct uniform-orbital result. Novelty is not claimed for incidence or Cesaro-projector formulas. Unindexed equivalences are an explicit residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed flat-band or association-scheme literature may contain an equivalent Schur-square rank criterion; searching does not demonstrate global priority.
A stronger general edge-cycle Hadamard-product spanning theorem might subsume the new sufficient condition even without mentioning quantum walks.
The 2026 Kang preprint has a withdrawn earlier version; comparison relies only on revised v2.

value.rationale: Addresses a prominent full-rank average-mixing question with a checkable root-graph local sufficient criterion, quantitative spectral positivity uniform over each finite graph, and an infinite class of heterogeneous Cartesian-product line graphs. Gives the sharp hypercube dimension threshold between C4 and d>=3. The mechanism is structural rather than a finite census, and the result has a motivated gap and plausible use to certify quantum mixing on broad product networks.
